rule: Responsibility/dataflow evidence is required before refactoring; file length and dataclass count are diagnostics only.

phases.evidence: evidence_verification.py is 1253 lines but 1133 lines belong to one VerificationMixin authority surface; size alone does not prove a safe ownership split.
evidence_packet.py is 1018 lines and AgentPacketMixin is 996 lines; methods form decision brief, agent-start evidence, config evidence and budget projection, but no duplicate writer was proven.
test_shards.py contains selection, identity, validation and CLI projection around the same qualification-selection contract; no second authoritative membership writer was found.
repository_task_action.py is dominated by TaskActionMixin; method groups are broad but still participate in one task-action decision pipeline.
dataclass count alone does not establish duplicate authoritative state; inspected declarations are predominantly immutable evidence/value contracts or local validation state.
no newly proven pair of independently persisted receipts owns the same fact.
release-correctness membership remains derived from repository-owned classification rather than separately authored membership.
prior AST snapshot reuse remains intact; no fresh duplicate projection defect was proven.
no duplicate repository identity writer was proven.
no new miss class or ambiguity regression justifies retrieval expansion.
no current profile evidence identifies storage as a dominant bottleneck or duplicate authority.
no redundant externally consumed representation was proven safe to remove.
negative evidence remains repository evidence and does not become retry/execution authority.
Hashmarks remains repository intelligence; execution/certification ownership remains external.
No product refactor admitted without a proven duplicate writer, mixed authority defect, correctness defect, or measured dominant cost.
